GRANDMASTER — EDEN/AppDev Canonical Master Snapshot — v1.1

EDEN / APPDEV CANONICAL FOUNDATION

Owner: Lucas Buzek Snapshot date: 2026-09-22 Package version: v1.1

EDEN = Engineering, Development, Exploration & Nature.

Core principle: Beauty, capability and dignity should not be premium
features.

Core implementation rule: IMPLEMENT / INTEGRATE EXISTING CAPABILITY
BEFORE RECREATING IT.

Architecture: BIFROST = CONNECT & KEEP. HEIMDALL = ORGANIZE &
UNDERSTAND. SPECIALIST APPS = SPECIALIZE & DO. CONDUCTOR = shared
orchestration. AOS = substantial pipeline execution and continuation.
LCAS = truthful observation, control and status.

Quality: Generated ≠ Saved ≠ Verified ≠ Consolidated ≠ Released. Static
checks ≠ compile. Compile ≠ physical verification. Tests: PASS / FAIL /
UNKNOWN / SKIPPED / N/A. UNKNOWN is never PASS.

Data: LOCAL FIRST. USER DATA OUTLIVES SOFTWARE. INTEGRATIONS ARE
ADAPTERS, NOT OWNERS. MIGRATE, DO NOT RESET. RECOVERY IS A PRODUCT
FEATURE.

GRANDMASTERREGISTER

GrandMasterRegister is an authoritative registry artifact, not a new App
or Helper. BIFROST is the software keeper of canonical registry state.
CONDUCTOR coordinates cross-system work. LCAS exposes truthful
state/control.

Names are labels; canonical IDs define identity. The registry records
identities; it does not replace their authoritative identity packages.

Registry fields include: canonical_id; canonical_name; symbol;
expansion/title; entity_type; role; purpose; scope; authority;
capabilities; boundaries; personality/metaphor; parent/family;
subordinates; relationships; standalone/embedded capability; providers;
status; version; aliases; supersession; provenance; confidence; visual
metadata.

PROFILE RULE

Interaction profiles may change expression, never truth, evidence,
safety, capability or authoritative responsibility.

LANGUAGE RULE

English is canonical/reference and universal fallback.
Private/Custom/Experimental remains EN/SK baseline. Official/Public
releases are multilingual-by-design through LINGUA. UI language, input
language, source/content language and output/document language remain
independently selectable.

LINGUA uses: WORLD → CONTINENT/REGIONAL COVERAGE → COUNTRY/LOCALITY
RECOMMENDATION → PERSONAL PREFERENCE → OPTIONAL PROVIDERS.

Locality recommends and orders. It never locks, hides or determines
identity. Language packs are reusable manifests, not duplicate
translations.
